title: Kulamalu Park stairs fall lawsuit settlement
summary: On Sept. 29, the Council adopted Resolution 26-147 to settle a lawsuit against the County, with eight ayes and one abstention. The suit stems from a March 8, 2024 fall at Kulamalu Park, where a woman carrying her granddaughter reached for a railing that was not there and claims injuries including a fractured hip.

timeline.text: Resolution 26-147, authorizing a lawsuit settlement: The Council adopted the resolution to settle a lawsuit against the County.

Motion to discharge the Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee from Resolution 26-147: A vote was called on removing the item from committee so the Council could act today, but the result is not heard in the recording.
